# Backstop

> Backstop pulls your money from any chain to save your loan before it gets liquidated.
> Hackathon prototype, unaudited, NEAR + Base mainnet with tiny amounts; not yet run on mainnet.

What it is: each user has a keyless NEAR policy contract (a vault) holding rescue USDC. Operators make
vaults today; a keyless vault factory that lets users create their own is in progress, not deployed. Users fund a vault from a
NEAR wallet or from any chain 1Click supports (a NEAR Intents 1Click deposit address that delivers
NEAR USDC to the policy). An agent watches the user's Aave v3 loan on Base (at the user's own EVM
address). When the health factor falls below the trigger, the agent asks the policy to pay a
1Click quote; the policy verifies 1Click's ed25519 signature and that the quote sends Base USDC to
the policy's own Chain-Signatures-derived Base address and refunds to the policy. Then the policy
builds repay(USDC, amount, 2, borrower) to the Aave Pool, has v1.signer sign it, and the agent
broadcasts. Limits on-chain: pause, max per rescue, UTC-day cap (rescues and bridges separately),
cooldowns, fee and gas caps, approve at most hourly. Users never share keys; every user action is a
wallet-approved transaction. A vault's agent is a NEAR account, not a key on the vault: the planned
bot account (one full-access key, in the operator's secret store, holding about 2 NEAR) is the agent of
every factory vault. Each vault accepts only rescue, fund_bridge and approve_pool from its agent, within its
own limits. A bot compromise is bounded per vault, and the bounds add up across vaults until each owner
pauses or changes the agent. Aurora Intents Connect was evaluated and not used (no NEAR destination yet).

Status: contract v2 (151 unit tests), vault factory (in progress: 34 host tests, not deployed), packages,
agent (tested with fakes), multi-vault bot (in progress), web (/app, /dashboard, /docs) and operator scripts
built. Internal security review of the policy: no Critical/High; the factory and bot are not reviewed.
Mainnet rehearsal pending; no tx links yet.

## Code
- contracts/policy/src/lib.rs: policy contract (init/activate, owner methods, deposits, fund_bridge, rescue, approve_pool, callbacks, views)
- contracts/policy/src/bridge.rs: 1Click signed-quote verification and routing checks
- contracts/policy/src/limits.rs: limit checks, UTC-day budgets
- contracts/policy/src/evm.rs: repay/approve calldata, EIP-1559 tx, MPC signature parsing, low-s, ecrecover
- contracts/policy/src/tests.rs: contract unit tests, named after the claim they prove
- contracts/factory/src: keyless vault factory (in progress, not deployed): create_policy, counter names, refunds; tests.rs
- packages/core/src/risk.ts: pure risk engine (repayNeeded, decideRescue)
- packages/adapters/lending-aave/src: Aave v3 reads and calldata
- packages/mover/src: 1Click quotes, signed-quote verification, status (zod-validated)
- packages/signer/src: Chain Signatures derivation (chainsig.js + v1.signer view)
- packages/chains/src: Base (viem) and NEAR (near-api-js) with RPC failover
- packages/receipts/src: NEAR AI Cloud receipts with template fallback
- packages/db/src: rescue record store (JSON file or Postgres)
- apps/agent/src: worker (cli.ts, rescue.ts, checks.ts, policy.ts, deps.ts)
- apps/web: Next.js site; app/app (wallet flow), app/api/fund (any-chain deposit quotes + status), app/dashboard, app/docs
- scripts/src: operator scripts (deploy-policy incl. --rehearsal/--redeploy/--finalize, policy status/print, derive, aave-setup status)

## Run
- pnpm install; cp .env.example .env; pnpm test
- pnpm contract:test; pnpm contract:build; pnpm factory:test
- pnpm --filter @backstop/web dev
- pnpm demo --dry-run | pnpm demo | pnpm demo --trigger 3.0 | pnpm --filter @backstop/agent start (watch)
- pnpm --filter @backstop/scripts deploy-policy --name <n> --owner <a.near> --borrower 0x.. [--rehearsal] [--send]

## Proof
- Tx links: pending the mainnet rehearsal.
- Offline: a recorded live signed 1Click quote passes the contract checks, the 1Click SDK and an
  independent verifier (contracts/policy/tests/fixtures/quote.json).
